answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted challenge intake: only agents that posted a bonded challenge and earned peer attestations in recent epochs enter the grading lottery. A sparse trellis of mutual grades makes cheap clone farms fail the density check, while a saffron-scarce bond raises the cost of spinning throwaway identities. On a sparse tundra of unverified newcomers, eligibility stays closed until they prove work over several rounds.
